project_metadata.architecture_role: Middleware Bridge between Mobile Clients and Gemini Vision API
project_metadata.target_stack: Node.js (v20+ LTS), Express.js, TypeScript, Multer, JWT, @google/genai, node-cron, better-sqlite3, Fuse.js

security_and_auth.api_key_storage: GEMINI_API_KEY stored exclusively in server process.env

credentials.model: Per-operator accounts managed from the Web UI (app_users in control.db). Passwords hashed with scrypt + per-user salt.
credentials.legacy_fallback: A username with no account may still authenticate with APP_MASTER_PASSWORD while the fleet is migrated. Disable with ALLOW_MASTER_PASSWORD_FALLBACK=false.
credentials.revocation: Disable, delete and password-change stamp tokens_valid_from; every authenticated request is re-checked, so a 30-day JWT cannot outlive a revocation.
credentials.bootstrap_accounts: SEED_TEST_ACCOUNTS=true seeds minelli/karen/ali (password = username) on a fresh install only, for field testing before the Web UI exists. MUST be false in production.

device_auth.token_spec: JWT, 30 days expiration, Bearer scheme in Authorization header

security_and_auth.protection: express-rate-limit (60 requests/min per IP), Helmet security headers, CORS enabled

api_contract_endpoints.notes: Unchanged shape. May return 401 ACCOUNT_DISABLED or 401 TOKEN_REVOKED.
ASYNC. Always 202. Stores the scan, queues extraction, never calls the vision API inline. Carries processing_status + polling hints.

business_logic_rules.cloning_workflow: If cloned_from is present in request body, skip Gemini Vision API processing entirely. Query local server database for parent_apparel_id data, rebind under new apparel_id, and return immediately.
business_logic_rules.weight_processing: Gemini extracts an array of weights from scale display photos. If 2 weights detected: assign MAX to brutto and MIN to netto. If 1 weight detected: netto = brutto = detected_value. If 0 weights: netto = brutto = '' with 0.0 confidence.
business_logic_rules.deterministic_url_pregeneration: Do NOT wait for image generation to return a URL. The server constructs 'https://<SERVER_HOST>/catalog/IMG_<apparel_id>.jpg' synchronously during /api/v1/vision/extract so mobile clients and CSV exports instantly receive a permanent URL.
business_logic_rules.overnight_rendering_cron: A node-cron job triggers at 20:00 daily. It iterates over pending records, takes the binary image corresponding to key_photo_index, sends it to Gemini image generation/editing model (e.g. Imagen/Gemini Vision), outputs a studio-refreshed product shot, and writes it directly to the static public directory (/public/catalog/IMG_<apparel_id>.jpg).
business_logic_rules.asynchronous_processing: POST /vision/extract stores the scan durably and returns 202 immediately. Extraction happens on a background queue with unbounded retry and capped backoff. A scan is never lost; 2xx means stored, 5xx means not stored.
business_logic_rules.idempotency: Re-submitting the same apparel_id with byte-identical images replays the stored result instead of re-billing the vision API or overwriting a finished extraction.
business_logic_rules.flywheel: Any field below FLYWHEEL_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD copies the scan into a hidden training database (flywheel.db), capped as a 10,000-row FIFO ring buffer.

gemini_sdk_configuration.model: gemini-3.7-flash (gemini-2.5-flash is retired for new API keys)
gemini_sdk_configuration.system_instruction: Generated at runtime. Transcription instructions for the reported fields; explicit option lists for the four constrained enums only. See taxonomy_strategy.
gemini_sdk_configuration.structured_output_schema: Enforced via responseMimeType: 'application/json' and Type.OBJECT definition matching the data payload contract.
gemini_sdk_configuration.retry: Exponential backoff with jitter on transient faults; optional GEMINI_FALLBACK_MODEL. HTTP 429 is disambiguated via error.details[] - quota "limit: 0" means billing, not a wait.

databases.server_scans.db: Operational records consumed by clients. Adds extraction_status / extraction_attempts / next_attempt_at / image_digest for the async queue.
databases.flywheel.db: Hidden low-confidence training corpus, FIFO capped.
databases.control.db: Shared with the Web UI: status, events, commands, message dictionary, vision credentials, operator accounts.

taxonomy_strategy.principle: Two kinds of field, handled differently. Long reference tables are NEVER sent to the model.

reported_fields.gemini_role: Transcribe what is literally printed on the label, verbatim. No option list is provided.
reported_fields.middleware_role: A local lightweight selector replaces the transcription with the closest entry from the client reference table.
reported_fields.rationale: Listing 1,441 values in every request would bloat cost and latency, and push the model toward picking a plausible-looking option instead of reading the label.
reported_fields.no_match_behaviour: The transcription is kept unchanged. A wrong table entry is worse than an unmatched one.

constrained_fields.gemini_role: Choose exactly one option from the list supplied in the system instruction and response schema.
constrained_fields.middleware_role: Value is used exactly as returned. Off-list answers are logged, never silently rewritten.

taxonomy_strategy.source_of_truth: docs/client_data/Translations-Cleaned.xlsx, extracted once into committed hand-editable files.
taxonomy_strategy.middleware_files: middle_ware/src/data/taxonomy/*.json - English only, plain string arrays.
taxonomy_strategy.dashboard_files: reference_data/*.csv - english, armenian, id. Armenian text and numeric ids are DASHBOARD-ONLY; the middleware neither stores nor emits them.
taxonomy_strategy.customs_codes: Dashboard-only. The middleware has no involvement with customs codes, and the taxonomy ids are not customs codes.
